ItemId.description: Optional identifier of the data set. When it matches a stored data set, that data set is updated; otherwise the data set is matched by Name. A new data set keeps this identifier when it is up to 26 letters, digits, dashes and underscores, and gets a generated one otherwise.

Name.description: Technical name of the data set, which reports, pipelines and its read permission store. A data set without a matching ItemId is matched by this name. It can't change once created. Made from DisplayText when omitted.

DisplayText.description: Name of the data set shown in the admin UI and in data source pickers.

Description.description: Optional description of the data set.

ConnectionId.description: Identifier of the connection the data set reads.

ConnectionName.description: Technical name of the connection the data set reads, used when no connection has ConnectionId.

Resource.description: What the data set reads at the connection: a table or view, an index, an API path, or a media file.

AccessMode.description: Live reads the source on every read; Imported copies the rows into the site on a schedule. Defaults to Live when the connector can read live.

IsEnabled.description: Whether the data set is offered to reports and pipelines and refreshed. Defaults to true.

Name.description: Name reports and pipelines read the field by. Made from SourceName when omitted.

SourceName.description: Name of the column, property or member at the source.

DisplayName.description: Label of the field. Defaults to Name.

Type.description: Type the field is read as.

IsIdentifier.description: Whether the field identifies a row. An incremental refresh needs at least one.

IsIncluded.description: Whether reports and pipelines see the field. Defaults to true.

Fields.description: The fields of the data set. When omitted on a new data set, they are read from the source if it can be reached, and otherwise at the first refresh.

DefaultDateField.description: Name of an included date field that reports filter by default.

Mode.description: Whether a refresh reads every row, or only the rows changed since the last one.

IncrementalField.description: For an incremental refresh: the date or number field that grows when a row changes.

IntervalMinutes.description: Minutes between scheduled refreshes. Null refreshes only on demand.

SchemaChangePolicy.description: Whether a refresh accepts a change of the source's fields, or fails and keeps the rows it has.

Refresh.description: How an imported data set is refreshed.

Query.description: Optional SELECT statement read instead of the table or view named by Resource.

RelationalDataSetSettings.description: The settings of a data set of a SqlServer (relational) connection.

RecordsPath.description: The path to the array of records in the response.

Pagination.description: How pages are requested: Type, PageParameter, FirstPage, OffsetParameter, SizeParameter, PageSize, CursorParameter, NextPath and MaxPages.

HttpApiDataSetSettings.description: The settings of a data set of an HttpApi connection.

ElasticsearchDataSetSettings.description: The settings of a data set of an Elasticsearch connection.

MediaFileDataSetSettings.description: The settings of a data set of a MediaFiles connection.

Properties.description: The connector's settings of the data set, keyed by the name of their type. Each settings object given replaces the stored one; settings not given are kept. Enumerations travel as their names.

CreatedUtc.description: Optional creation timestamp to preserve when importing exported records.

ModifiedUtc.description: Optional last-modified timestamp to preserve when importing exported records.

Author.description: Optional author name recorded with the data set.

DataSets.description: The connected data sets to create or update. Imported data sets that hold no rows yet are queued for their first import.
